Last week brought a scoring model from Microsoft, a new leader on the voice-cloning leaderboard, and Z.ai's first model built for one profession.

━━━ SPECIALIZED

🎯 Microsoft-Decision-1 — Doesn't write text. It returns calibrated probabilities over fixed options, for routing, classification and guardrails. Post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B. 9B · 32K context · $0.042 per 1M input, output free · Released Oct 9.
⚡ API live · Foundry · OpenRouter. → OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/microsoft/microsoft-decision-1)

🎯 HeyGen Voice — Voice cloning that fits the scene: it reads the target image so the delivery and room sound match the video. Ranked #1 on the Artificial Analysis controlled-voice arena (Elo 1201, Oct 9 snapshot). Ahead of Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus and Eleven v4 Turbo.
🔒 In HeyGen. → HeyGen Research (https://www.heygen.com/research/heygen-voice-scene-aware-voice-cloning)

🎯 GLM-Legal — Z.ai's legal model, built on GLM-5.3-Flash for contract review, evidence analysis and compliance work. 19.2% all-pass on Harvey LAB, checked independently by Vals. Released Oct 12.
🔒 Application-only beta, AutoClaw support coming. → Z.ai (https://z.ai/blog/glm-legal)
